answer_1.quote: We collect human-written texts from a set of benchmark datasets, which cover diverse writing tasks including: (1) Opinion statement..., (2) News article writing..., (3) Question answering..., (4) Story generation..., (5) Commonsense reasoning..., (6) Knowledge illustration..., (7) Scientific writing...
answer_1.outputs: Machine-generated texts corresponding to each human-written instance, covering the various writing tasks.

answer_2.quote: We report AUROC (the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve) and AvgRec as the main evaluation metrics; we do not employ standard automatic generation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, or METEOR.

answer_3.quote: DetectGPT requires access to the generation LLM but is used as a detection method rather than a post‑hoc judge of generated text quality.

answer_4.quote: We hire 3 expert annotators to conduct independent annotation and average their performance. Human detection and Ask‑ChatGPT baselines were created by asking annotators to identify the source of each text.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to determine whether a given text was written by a human or generated by a machine.
